items.title: OpenAI GPT-Live-1.1 and GPT-Live-1.1 Quip: 13 new voices incl. two French, better accents
items.summary: OpenAI updated its voice model behind ChatGPT Voice, Codex and dots, adding 13 voices (two each in French, German, Hindi, Japanese, Korean and Mexican Spanish) and more natural accents. A mini variant, Quip, also ships. API access is 'coming soon' with no date; developers stay on the earlier model for now.
items.whyItMatters: Better French accents and native French voices are exactly what Romain on OpenAI Realtime needs, so watch for the API release to swap in.

items.title: Jev becomes Vercel's fastest-adopted AI model ever
items.summary: TypeSafe AI's Jev, launched September 15, is used by 35% of Vercel's paid teams within two weeks, nearly double the second-place model, per Vercel AI gateway data.
items.whyItMatters: A sign of how quickly developers switch models when one is clearly better, which is useful context for how often to re-evaluate the tutor's model stack.
